FB-GEM.id: Permata ini masuk ke Kotak Permatamu.
FB-GEM.en: This gem goes into your Gem box.

body.id: Pencernaan: mulut, kerongkongan, lambung, usus halus, lalu usus besar.
body.en: Digestion: mouth, oesophagus, stomach, small intestine, then large intestine.

body.id: Pernapasan: udara masuk lewat hidung ke paru-paru. Jantung memompa darah berisi oksigen ke seluruh tubuh.
body.en: Breathing: air goes in through the nose to the lungs. The heart pumps oxygen-rich blood all round the body.

body.id: Tulang dan otot bekerja sama supaya kita bisa bergerak.
body.en: Bones and muscles work together so we can move.

body.id: Rantai makanan menunjukkan siapa makan siapa. Energinya berawal dari Matahari.
body.en: A food chain shows who eats whom. Its energy starts with the Sun.

body.id: Produsen (tumbuhan) membuat makanan sendiri, konsumen makan makhluk lain, pengurai mengubah yang mati menjadi hara tanah.
body.en: Producers (plants) make their own food, consumers eat other living things, decomposers turn dead things into soil nutrients.

body.id: Hutan hujan, hutan mangrove, dan terumbu karang Indonesia adalah rumah bagi sangat banyak makhluk.
body.en: Indonesia's rainforests, mangroves and coral reefs are home to a huge number of living things.

meaning.en: Digestion starts here.

model_answer.id: Di mulut: gigi mengunyah dan air liur mulai mencerna makanan.
model_answer.en: In the mouth: teeth chew and saliva starts digesting the food.

meaning.en: Food's journey through the body.

model_answer.id: Mulut → kerongkongan → lambung → usus halus → usus besar.
model_answer.en: Mouth → oesophagus → stomach → small intestine → large intestine.

meaning.id: Organ ini bagian dari sistem apa?
meaning.en: Which system is this organ part of?

model_answer.id: Jantung: peredaran darah. Paru-paru: pernapasan. Gigi: pencernaan. Tulang dan otot: gerak.
model_answer.en: Heart: circulation. Lungs: breathing. Teeth: digestion. Bones and muscles: movement.

meaning.en: Air comes in here.

model_answer.id: Hidung menyaring, menghangatkan, dan melembapkan udara.
model_answer.en: Your nose filters, warms and moistens the air.

meaning.id: Organ mana yang menukar oksigen dan karbon dioksida?
meaning.en: Which organ swaps oxygen and carbon dioxide?

model_answer.id: Paru-paru: oksigen masuk ke darah, karbon dioksida keluar lewat napas.
model_answer.en: The lungs: oxygen enters the blood, carbon dioxide leaves as you breathe out.

meaning.id: Detak jantung anak saat duduk santai, per menit?
meaning.en: A child's heartbeats per minute when sitting still?

model_answer.id: Sekitar 70–100 kali per menit. Saat berlari, bisa jauh lebih cepat.
model_answer.en: About 70–100 beats a minute. When you run, it can be much faster.

meaning.en: Oxygen's journey through the body.

text.id: Jantung memompa darah ke seluruh tubuh
text.en: The heart pumps blood round the body

model_answer.id: Hidung → trakea → paru-paru → oksigen masuk darah → jantung memompanya ke seluruh tubuh.
model_answer.en: Nose → windpipe → lungs → oxygen enters the blood → the heart pumps it everywhere.

meaning.id: Otot yang kita perintah, atau bekerja sendiri?
meaning.en: Muscles we control, or muscles that work by themselves?

model_answer.id: Kita perintah: otot kaki, tangan, lengan. Bekerja sendiri: jantung dan usus, bahkan saat tidur.
model_answer.en: We control: leg, hand and arm muscles. By themselves: heart and gut, even while we sleep.

meaning.en: Food is digested entirely in the stomach.

model_answer.id: Mitos. Sebagian besar sari makanan dicerna dan diserap di usus halus.
model_answer.en: Myth. Most nutrients are digested and absorbed in the small intestine.

meaning.en: Organ and its job.

model_answer.id: Gigi mengunyah, lambung mengaduk, usus halus menyerap sari makanan, usus besar menyerap air.
model_answer.en: Teeth chew, the stomach churns, the small intestine absorbs nutrients, the large intestine absorbs water.

model_answer.id: Letakkan dua jari di pergelangan tanganmu. Hitung denyutnya selama 15 detik, lalu kalikan 4. Lompat-lompat selama 1 menit, lalu hitung lagi. Mana yang lebih cepat? Kenapa?
model_answer.en: Put two fingers on your wrist. Count the beats for 15 seconds, then multiply by 4. Jump for 1 minute and count again. Which is faster? Why?

meaning.id: Kegiatan mana yang paling melatih jantung?
meaning.en: Which activity trains your heart most?

model_answer.id: Berlari. Anak dianjurkan aktif bergerak sekitar 60 menit setiap hari.
model_answer.en: Running. Children are advised to be active for about 60 minutes every day.

meaning.en: Where does food go first?

model_answer.id: Mulut → lambung → usus halus.
model_answer.en: Mouth → stomach → small intestine.

meaning.en: Which organ do we breathe with?

model_answer.id: Paru-paru.
model_answer.en: The lungs.

meaning.id: Darah dipompa ke seluruh tubuh oleh ____.
meaning.en: Blood is pumped round the body by the ____.

model_answer.id: Jantung, otot yang tidak pernah berhenti bekerja.
model_answer.en: The heart, a muscle that never stops working.

meaning.en: Who eats what?

model_answer.id: Orangutan makan buah, kelinci makan sayuran, katak makan ulat dan serangga.
model_answer.en: Orangutans eat fruit, rabbits eat vegetables, frogs eat caterpillars and insects.

meaning.en: Producer, consumer or decomposer?

model_answer.id: Produsen: pohon, tanaman bunga. Konsumen: kelinci, harimau, orangutan. Pengurai: bakteri.
model_answer.en: Producers: tree, flowering plant. Consumers: rabbit, tiger, orangutan. Decomposer: bacteria.

meaning.id: Energi semua rantai makanan berasal dari…
meaning.en: The energy in every food chain comes from…

model_answer.id: Matahari. Tumbuhan menangkap cahayanya untuk membuat makanan.
model_answer.en: The Sun. Plants capture its light to make food.

meaning.en: Build the food chain.

model_answer.id: Daun → ulat → katak → ular.
model_answer.en: Leaves → caterpillar → frog → snake.

meaning.id: Hewan ini tinggal di hutan hujan Kalimantan dan Sumatra.
meaning.en: This animal lives in the rainforests of Borneo and Sumatra.

model_answer.id: Orangutan. Hutan hujan memberinya buah dan tempat bersarang di pohon.
model_answer.en: The orangutan. The rainforest gives it fruit and trees to nest in.

meaning.en: Rainforest or coral reef?

model_answer.id: Hutan hujan: orangutan, harimau sumatra, kupu-kupu. Terumbu karang: ikan karang, penyu.
model_answer.en: Rainforest: orangutan, Sumatran tiger, butterfly. Coral reef: reef fish, sea turtle.

meaning.en: Coral in the sea is a rock.

model_answer.id: Mitos. Karang adalah hewan kecil (polip) yang membangun rumah dari kapur.
model_answer.en: Myth. Corals are tiny animals (polyps) that build limestone homes.

meaning.id: Daun → ulat → katak → ular. Kalau ular hilang, siapa langsung bertambah?
meaning.en: Leaves → caterpillar → frog → snake. If snakes vanish, who increases first?

model_answer.id: Katak, karena tidak ada lagi yang memakannya. Lalu ulat bisa berkurang.
model_answer.en: Frogs, because nothing eats them any more. Then caterpillars may decrease.

meaning.id: Rumput menyimpan 1.000 bagian energi. Berapa yang sampai ke kambing?
meaning.en: Grass stores 1,000 units of energy. How much reaches the goat?

model_answer.id: Hanya sekitar 100, kira-kira sepersepuluh. Sisanya dipakai untuk hidup dan lepas sebagai panas.
model_answer.en: Only about 100, roughly a tenth. The rest is used for living and lost as heat.

meaning.id: Komodo hidup liar di pulau-pulau ini.
meaning.en: Komodo dragons live wild on these islands.

model_answer.id: Nusa Tenggara Timur: Pulau Komodo, Rinca, dan Flores.
model_answer.en: East Nusa Tenggara: Komodo, Rinca and Flores.

model_answer.id: Kubur kulit pisang di pot berisi tanah. Gali sedikit dan lihat setiap 3 hari. Siapa yang mengubahnya menjadi tanah? Pengurai: bakteri, jamur, dan cacing kecil! Cuci tangan sesudahnya.
model_answer.en: Bury a banana peel in a pot of soil. Dig a little and look every 3 days. Who turns it into soil? Decomposers: bacteria, fungi and little worms! Wash your hands afterwards.

meaning.id: Daun gugur diuraikan oleh ____ menjadi pupuk.
meaning.en: Fallen leaves are broken down into fertiliser by ____.

model_answer.id: Bakteri dan jamur, para pengurai.
model_answer.en: Bacteria and fungi, the decomposers.

meaning.en: Leaves → caterpillar → ____ → snake

model_answer.id: Katak makan ulat, lalu dimakan ular.
model_answer.en: Frogs eat caterpillars and are eaten by snakes.

meaning.en: Which one is a producer?

model_answer.id: Pohon: ia membuat makanannya sendiri dari cahaya matahari.
model_answer.en: The tree: it makes its own food from sunlight.

meaning.id: Siapa yang tinggal di terumbu karang?
meaning.en: Who lives on a coral reef?

model_answer.id: Ikan karang. Terumbu karang memberinya makanan dan tempat berlindung.
model_answer.en: Reef fish. The reef gives them food and shelter.

items.source: Encyclopaedia Britannica, "Wallace Line"; Alfred Russel Wallace, The Malay Archipelago (1869), chapters on Bali and Lombok.

model_answer.id: Di antara Bali dan Lombok ada garis tak terlihat: Garis Wallace. Hewan di sebelah baratnya mirip hewan Asia, di sebelah timurnya mulai mirip hewan Australia, misalnya burung kakatua. Selat Lombok yang dalam membuat hewan sulit menyeberang sejak dulu.
model_answer.en: Between Bali and Lombok runs an invisible line: the Wallace Line. Animals to the west are like Asian animals; to the east they start to look Australian, like cockatoos. The deep Lombok Strait has long kept animals from crossing.

meaning.id: Aku bekerja siang dan malam tanpa kamu suruh. Aku berdetak sekitar 100.000 kali sehari. Siapa aku?
meaning.en: I work day and night without being told. I beat about 100,000 times a day. Who am I?

model_answer.id: Jantung! Sekitar 100.000 detak setiap hari.
model_answer.en: Your heart! About 100,000 beats every day.
